text:
Haven't really touched ALT's since 2024 and those did OK overall.  Some winners (like SOL) and some losers, maybe a wash. Considering what people lost on ALT's, I'm happy with that.  

On Bitcoin, i sold at $80k the first time. Guess what, it's at $82k now.  Did I sell the top, no.  I ride trends and it takes a long time to see a trend break.  We didn't get a blowoff top that would help try to get out near a top.  

The Cycle has sucked all round.  Considering that, I'm happy with it overall.  Also on a video 4 days ago, you dont appreciate that markets move wildly and change direction often.  You're looking for predictions that stick, but i dont see markets like that.  I will change views immediately and rapidly as needed.  If you think changing views is a sign of "getting it wrong", then I'm not somebody you should follow.
